title: Do Validated LLM Judges Transfer to Real Chatbot Replies? Data, code and logs
description: Data, code and complete model-call logs for the article "Do Validated LLM Judges Transfer to Real Chatbot Replies? Judge Disagreement, Rule-Based Checks and Implications for Evaluating Conversational Agents". Includes the 160 requests with specifications, the replies of two open-source chatbots, the outputs of two open-weight LLM judges, rule-based checks, automatic metrics, analysis scripts and the values behind all tables and figures. Data are licensed CC BY 4.0; code is licensed MIT.
